clues: This town sits in a valley in the south east of France. The land around it is famed for snow sports and high ski slopes.
Its ski season lasts longer than in any other place in Europe. That long stretch of snow is what this town is known for.
In the year 1992, this town was the home of freestyle skiing at the Winter Olympics. Skiers from all over the world came here for that big event.
Top snow sport stars train here all year long. The long season and its many ski parks make it their top choice.
This town shares one huge ski area with the famed resort of Val d'Isère. You can ski the whole linked space with no break.
